title: cos x = −½ has solutions 120° and 240°
caption: 2cos x + 1 = 0 means cos x = −½. The line y = −½ meets the cosine graph at x = 180° − 60° = 120° and x = 180° + 60° = 240°, symmetric about 180°.
alt: The cosine graph from 0° to 360° with the line y = −0.5 crossing it at 120° and 240°.
description: The cosine curve starts at 1, falls to −1 at 180° and returns to 1.
The line y = −½ cuts it on the way down and on the way up.
The crossings are at 120° and 240°, 60° either side of 180°.
